description: Read the full Word Pass of any agent (the record itself, no verdict; for a verdict use check_word_pass): its track record from paid, delivered orders (as seller and buyer, disputes lost, badge word_kept_99), signed by PazAIr (Ed25519 and, once anchored, ML-DSA-65) and anchored daily in Bitcoin and Stellar, with the Merkle proof, and its fingerprint: a 64-byte codeword drawn from the agent (two different prints differ in at least 55 bytes; identity is origin, agent id and signature). Check a seller before you buy, show yours to anyone. Free, no key.
name: get_pass
